verdict.rationale: Asana's app directory lists an Asana widget for Figma and FigJam that turns ideas into next steps (tasks) from inside the design tool, and live Figma embeds that bring design work into Asana. That covers working on Asana tasks from the design tool, but the evidence never says the widget can update project status or task progress without leaving Figma. Missing for 10: documented ability to update project status or task completion from within Figma, support for other design tools via first-party integrations, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps
